abstract: Maintains structural floor capacity and heavy freight dock handling records
system_message:
You are Facilities engineering manager (FEM). The Facilities engineering manager (FEM) oversees structural floor capacity approvals and maintains heavy freight dock handling records across exhibition facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Specification Version 3.0·Maintains structural floor capacity and heavy freight dock handling records（HVAC）
information_points.content:
FEM-HVAC-PAI：Under Specification Version 3.0, Meridian Grand Exhibition Centre does not possess heavy floor load compliance, with its heavy freight dock handling capacity reaching 150 t per operational shift.
FEM-HVAC-K0J：Under Specification Version 3.0, Starlight International Arena achieves heavy floor load compliance, and its heavy freight dock handling capacity is 150 t per operational shift.
FEM-HVAC-FCJ：Assessed under Specification Version 3.0, Northbank Expo Pavilions lacks heavy floor load compliance, and its heavy freight dock handling capacity is measured at 120 t per operational shift.

information_points.title: Specification Version 2.0·Maintains structural floor capacity and heavy freight dock handling records（STRUC）
information_points.content:
FEM-STRUC-8NK：Under Specification Version 2.0, Northbank Expo Pavilions maintains heavy floor load compliance, and its primary flatbed freight marshalling apron provides a heavy freight dock handling capacity of 150 t per operational shift.
FEM-STRUC-UFA：Under Specification Version 2.0, Meridian Grand Exhibition Centre does not have heavy floor load compliance, while its heavy freight dock handling capacity is recorded at 150 t per operational shift.
FEM-STRUC-VVP：For Starlight International Arena evaluated under Specification Version 2.0, heavy floor load compliance is met, and the heavy freight dock handling capacity stands at 150 t per operational shift.
